caption: The synchronous path finishes the send only after the matching receive takes the message. A plain blocking send would return as soon as the bytes are in the buffer. The dashed self arrow is an asynchronous send returning at once; delivery still takes the same time.

spec.aria: A sender copies a one megabyte message into a kernel buffer, a receiver takes it, a synchronous send returns after that receive, and a dashed self arrow shows an asynchronous send returning at once.
